title: Other payloads
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 2.1 Subclaims defined in this guide; HCert logical model; MedicationTreatmentLineMin logical model (ph4h); DDCC Implementation Guide.

statements.label: Other payloads
statements.requirement: Subclaim 5 SHALL have a typed codec holding a URI string. Subclaims 1, 3, 4 and -7 SHALL at least be issuable and verifiable as raw CBOR payloads. Typed codecs for them MAY follow.
